sentences.text: Hey everyone, today we are, um, looking at the lens I have used all year.
It is not the one the reviews told you to buy.
We started in 2019 with three people and one, um, borrowed camera.
Most of that first year was spent, um, returning gear that did not survive a shoot.
The cheapest lens here outperforms the ten thousand dollar one.
I know how that sounds, so, um, let me show you the frames.
The coating on the new glass handles backlight without flaring.
The coating on the new glass handles backlight without flaring.
Look at the edges of this frame, um, and then at the same edge on the expensive one.
And when the light drops, this is where it earns its price.
So the takeaway is: buy the glass, not the body.
It is the only piece of kit I have never, um, regretted.
